kashika: कर्मादिभ्योऽन्यः प्रातिपदिकार्थव्यतिरिक्तः स्वस्वामिसंबन्धादिः शेषः, तत्र षष्ठी विभक्तिर्भवति। राज्ञः पुरुषः। पशोः पादः। पितुः पुत्रः॥
kashikaEnglish: In remaining cases (relations like ownership), genitive is used: राज्ञः पुरुषः 'king's man', पशोः पादः 'animal's foot'.
englishFull:
The 6th case-affix (genitive) is used in remaining cases — relations like owner-property, whole-part, etc., distinct from verb-related meanings.

**Examples:**
| Expression | Meaning |
|------------|---------|
| राज्ञः पुरुषः | "the king's man" |
| पशोः पादः | "beast's foot" |
| पितुः पुत्रः | "father's son" |

This is the "default" genitive for possession and similar relations.
